VAULT_KEY_INVALID: The provider rejected this API key. Check the key and try again.
VAULT_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: This key has no quota left at the provider. Add credit there or use another key.
VAULT_REGION_BLOCKED: The provider doesn't serve requests from this region. Use a key or endpoint that does.
VAULT_TEST_TIMEOUT: Couldn't reach the provider in 20 seconds. Try again.
LOCAL_SERVER_UNREACHABLE: Nothing answered at this address. Check the URL and that the server is running and reachable from SurefyOS.
VAULT_CREDENTIAL_NOT_FOUND: This key or server no longer exists.
VAULT_CREDENTIAL_REVOKED: This key was revoked and can't be changed. Add a new key instead.
VAULT_PERSONAL_KEYS_DISABLED: Your organization doesn't allow personal API keys.
VAULT_PROVIDER_NOT_ALLOWED: Your organization's access policy doesn't allow this provider.
VAULT_ROTATION_MISMATCH: A replacement key must use the same provider and scope as the key it replaces.
VAULT_SERVER_IN_USE: A model on this server is still in use. Choose another embedding model or decision model first.
